stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Is 4417w a ticket, or a typo?

stations.title: Your look-up
stations.gap: Every typo looks like a ticket

stations.title: Dorrit's counter
stations.text: A plain line for whatever was typed.

captions: Dorrit types a ticket number a customer reads out, and her finger slips: 4417w.
The look-up reads the number at the front, and tells her repair 4417 is ready.
You check what was typed before using it, and say no without stopping the program.
Now 4417w is caught as a typo, and an empty line is a typo too, not a crash.
Every no is a plain answer. Next, problems that must travel further than one call.
